<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Mouhryn Kanth — E-Portfolio</title>
<style>
:root{
 --navy:#061426;--navy2:#0a1e38;--blue:#1d7cff;--ice:#dcecff;
 --white:#f7fbff;--muted:#8fa5bd;--black:#02070e;--line:rgba(166,202,238,.16);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
 background:var(--black);color:var(--white);
 font-family:Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
 overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.6;
}
body:before{
 content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:-2;
 background:
 radial-gradient(circle at 80% 10%,rgba(29,124,255,.20),transparent 25%),
 radial-gradient(circle at 10% 70%,rgba(29,124,255,.10),transparent 25%),
 linear-gradient(115deg,#02070e,#061426 55%,#02070e);
}
body:after{
 content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:10;opacity:.18;
 background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px),
 linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px);
 background-size:55px 55px;
 mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,black,transparent 85%);
}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.nav{
 position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:66px;z-index:100;
 background:rgba(2,7,14,.65);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
 border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)
}
.navin{width:min(1180px,92%);height:100%;margin:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.logo{font-weight:850;letter-spacing:-.4px}.logo span{color:var(--blue)}
.links{display:flex;gap:27px;font-size:13px;color:#aebfd1}.links a{transition:.25s}.links a:hover{color:#fff}
.hero{min-height:100vh;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:120px 0 80px;overflow:hidden}
.hero .orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(2px);pointer-events:none}
.orb.one{width:420px;height:420px;right:-130px;top:100px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(29,124,255,.22),transparent 68%);animation:drift 9s ease-in-out infinite}
.orb.two{width:260px;height:260px;left:-100px;bottom:30px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(68,161,255,.16),transparent 68%);animation:drift 12s ease-in-out infinite reverse}
.container{width:min(1180px,92%);margin:auto}
.heroGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:80px;align-items:center}
.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(29,124,255,.35);padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(29,124,255,.08);color:#b9d8ff;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase}
h1{font-size:clamp(62px,9vw,126px);line-height:.86;letter-spacing:-7px;margin:23px 0}
.gradient{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#fff 10%,#9fcaff 48%,#2787ff 100%);color:transparent;background-clip:text;-webkit-background-clip:text}
.heroText{font-size:20px;color:var(--muted);max-width:690px}
.actions{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:30px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{padding:13px 19px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:800;transition:.3s}
.btn.primary{background:var(--white);color:#061426;border-color:var(--white)}
.btn.secondary{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.portraitFrame{
 position:relative;width:min(310px,68vw);margin:auto;padding:7px;
 background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.8),rgba(29,124,255,.75),rgba(255,255,255,.12));
 border-radius:18px;
 transform:none;animation:portraitFloat 6s ease-in-out infinite;
 box-shadow:0 35px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.5)
}
.portraitFrame:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20px;border:1px solid rgba(29,124,255,.18);border-radius:22px;animation:spinBorder 12s linear infinite}
.portrait{width:100%;display:block;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;border-radius:13px}
.photoLabel{position:absolute;bottom:22px;left:22px;background:rgba(2,7,14,.76);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 13px;font-size:12px}
.photoLabel b{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:15px}
section{padding:130px 0}
.kicker{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#64a8ff;font-weight:900}
.head{font-size:clamp(44px,6vw,78px);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-4px;margin:7px 0 20px}
.sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:19px;max-width:780px}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(55px);transition:1s cubic-bezier(.18,.75,.2,1)}
.reveal.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
.panel{margin-top:35px;padding:40px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(13,35,61,.78),rgba(4,10,18,.8));border-radius:28px;box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.about{font-size:20px;color:#c1d0df;max-width:900px}
.infoGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
.info{padding:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);border-radius:16px}
.info small{display:block;color:#6e88a2;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.2px;font-size:10px}.info b{font-size:15px}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:15px;margin-top:35px}
.card{min-height:225px;padding:27px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:23px;background:rgba(7,21,37,.78);position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:.45s}
.card:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:110px;height:110px;right:-55px;bottom:-55px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(29,124,255,.12);transition:.45s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-9px);border-color:rgba(29,124,255,.55);box-shadow:0 25px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}.card:hover:after{transform:scale(2.2)}
.icon{font-size:30px;margin-bottom:23px}.card h3{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:7px}.card p{color:var(--muted)}
.achievements{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:16px;margin-top:35px}
.awardHero{min-height:430px;padding:38px;border-radius:28px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0c294c,#061426);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.awardHero .big{font-size:110px;font-weight:950;line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-8px;color:#dcecff}.awardHero h3{font-size:30px;margin-top:28px}.awardHero p{color:#8fa5bd;margin-top:8px}
.awardList{display:grid;gap:15px}.award{padding:25px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;background:#071526}.award b{color:#7db9ff;font-size:24px}.award span{display:block;color:#a8bacd;margin-top:4px}
.progress{margin-top:35px;display:grid;gap:15px}.prog{padding:22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}.progTop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between}.bar{height:7px;background:#13263d;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:12px}.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff,#2c89ff);border-radius:inherit;transition:1.7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.goal{margin-top:35px;min-height:500px;border-radius:32px;border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:55px;display:flex;align-items:end;background:
 radial-gradient(circle at 78% 28%,rgba(29,124,255,.26),transparent 25%),
 linear-gradient(135deg,#0b2340,#03080e 70%)}
.goal:before{content:"10B";position:absolute;right:-15px;top:-50px;font-size:250px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-15px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.goal h3{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,68px);letter-spacing:-3px;line-height:.95;position:relative}.goal p{color:#a7bbcf;max-width:760px;font-size:20px;margin-top:16px;position:relative}
.contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:15px;margin-top:35px}.detail{padding:25px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:#071526}.detail label{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#66809b}.detail p{margin-top:4px;color:#d6e3ef}
footer{padding:70px 0;text-align:center;color:#60758b;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
@keyframes portraitFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}
@keyframes drift{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}50%{transform:translate(30px,-25px)}}
@keyframes spinBorder{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@media(max-width:850px){.links{display:none}.heroGrid,.achievements,.contact{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{text-align:center}.heroText{margin:auto}.actions{justify-content:center}.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.infoGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.portraitFrame{margin-top:25px;width:min(270px,72vw)}}
@media(max-width:560px){section{padding:90px 0}.cards,.infoGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.panel,.goal{padding:28px}.hero h1{letter-spacing:-4px}.heroText{font-size:17px}.head{letter-spacing:-2px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<nav class="nav"><div class="navin"><a class="logo" href="#top">Mouhryn<span>.</span></a><div class="links"><a href="#about">About</a><a href="#skills">Skills</a><a href="#achievements">Achievements</a><a href="#progress">Progress</a><a href="#future">Future</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a></div></div></nav>

<header class="hero" id="top">
<div class="orb one"></div><div class="orb two"></div>
<div class="container heroGrid">
<div class="reveal">
<div class="eyebrow">JSS Private School · 10B · Falcon House</div>
<h1>Hi, I'm<br><span class="gradient">Mouhryn.</span></h1>
<p class="heroText">A student from Dubai who loves music, dance, science, friends and the idea of building a life worth remembering.</p>
<div class="actions"><a class="btn primary" href="#about">Enter my portfolio ↓</a><a class="btn secondary" href="#contact">My details</a></div>
</div>
<div class="reveal">
<div class="portraitFrame">
<img class="portrait" src="data:image/png;base64,">
<div class="photoLabel"><b>Mouhryn Kanth</b>Class 10B · Falcon House</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</header>

<section id="about"><div class="container reveal"><div class="kicker">01 · About</div><h2 class="head">More than a student.</h2><p class="sub">A little context behind the person.</p>
<div class="panel"><p class="about">I am a student of JSS Private School, Dubai. I was born in Swamiyarmadam, Kanyakumari, Tamil Nadu, India, and have grown up in Dubai. I enjoy dancing, listening to music, going out and spending time with friends. Academically, I am especially interested in Biology, Chemistry and English. I like subjects that spark curiosity, and I enjoy exploring ideas and different reactions in Chemistry.</p>
<div class="infoGrid"><div class="info"><small>Nationality</small><b>Indian</b></div><div class="info"><small>School</small><b>JSS Private School</b></div><div class="info"><small>Class</small><b>10B</b></div><div class="info"><small>House</small><b>Falcon</b></div><div class="info"><small>Class Teacher</small><b>Ms. Sivashanthini</b></div><div class="info"><small>Born</small><b>19 February 2011</b></div></div></div>
</div></section>

<section id="skills"><div class="container reveal"><div class="kicker">02 · Skills & Interests</div><h2 class="head">What keeps me moving.</h2><p class="sub">The things I enjoy outside the classroom.</p>
<div class="cards">
<div class="card"><div class="icon">🏊</div><h3>Swimming</h3><p>I can swim and have represented my school in competition, earning second place.</p></div>
<div class="card"><div class="icon">🛼</div><h3>Skating</h3><p>A skill I enjoy for its movement, challenge and sense of freedom.</p></div>
<div class="card"><div class="icon">💃</div><h3>Dancing</h3><p>One of my favourite ways to enjoy music and express myself.</p></div>
<div class="card"><div class="icon">🎧</div><h3>Music</h3><p>Listening to music is a big part of how I relax and spend my free time.</p></div>
<div class="card"><div class="icon">🧪</div><h3>Chemistry</h3><p>I enjoy trying different reactions and understanding what happens behind them.</p></div>
<div class="card"><div class="icon">📖</div><h3>English</h3><p>English is one of my favourite subjects because I enjoy communication and creativity.</p></div>
</div></div></section>

<section id="achievements"><div class="container reveal"><div class="kicker">03 · Achievements</div><h2 class="head">Proof that practice pays off.</h2>
<div class="achievements"><div class="awardHero"><div class="big">1st</div><h3>Storymaking & Presentation</h3><p>First place in a school storymaking and presentation project.</p></div><div class="awardList"><div class="award"><b>2nd place</b><span>School swimming competition</span></div><div class="award"><b>1st place</b><span>School running event</span></div><div class="award"><b>2nd place</b><span>School running event</span></div><div class="award"><b>1st place</b><span>Storymaking & presentation project</span></div></div></div>
</div></section>

<section id="progress"><div class="container reveal"><div class="kicker">04 · Academic Progress</div><h2 class="head">The next level.</h2><p class="sub">My targets are about improving consistently, not just chasing one result.</p>
<div class="panel progress">
<div class="prog"><div class="progTop"><b>Pre-midterm attainment</b><span>55%</span></div><div class="bar"><i data-width="55%"></i></div></div>
<div class="prog"><div class="progTop"><b>Pre-midterm target</b><span>70%+</span></div><div class="bar"><i data-width="70%"></i></div></div>
<div class="prog"><div class="progTop"><b>Midterm target</b><span>70%+</span></div><div class="bar"><i data-width="70%"></i></div></div>
<div class="prog"><div class="progTop"><b>Boards & pre-boards target</b><span>80%+</span></div><div class="bar"><i data-width="80%"></i></div></div>
</div></div></section>

<section id="future"><div class="container reveal"><div class="kicker">05 · Future</div><h2 class="head">I don't know every step.<br>And that's the point.</h2>
<div class="goal"><div><h3>Make it big in life.</h3><p>I want to earn a good degree, become successful, build a happy life and have the freedom to explore the world. Becoming a Chartered Accountant is one of my current goals, but I also want to stay open to the opportunities and surprises that life brings.</p></div></div></div></section>

<section id="contact"><div class="container reveal"><div class="kicker">06 · Profile</div><h2 class="head">The details.</h2>
<div class="contact">
<div class="detail"><label>School email</label><p>mouhrynkanth@jsspsdubai.com</p></div><div class="detail"><label>Class teacher</label><p>Ms. Sivashanthini</p></div>
<div class="detail"><label>Parents</label><p>Suresh Kumar Shunmugavel & Sucithra Suresh Kumar</p></div><div class="detail"><label>Place of birth</label><p>Swamiyarmadam, Kanyakumari, Tamil Nadu, India</p></div>
</div></div></section>

<footer>© 2026 Mouhryn Kanth Suresh Kumar · JSS Private School · E-Portfolio</footer>

<script>
const io=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
 entries.forEach(e=>{
  if(e.isIntersecting){
   e.target.classList.add("show");
   e.target.querySelectorAll(".bar i").forEach(b=>b.style.width=b.dataset.width);
  }
 });
},{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll(".reveal").forEach(x=>io.observe(x));
</script>
</body>
</html>
